chunks: And I asked him about the fingers: are they equal in the diyah? He said: “Yes.” He said: And I asked him about the teeth, so he said: “Their diyah is equal.”

key_terms.الدِّيَةِ: the prescribed financial compensation for bodily injury
key_terms.الْأَسْنَانِ: the teeth, treated here as equal in compensation
key_terms.الْأَصَابِعِ: the fingers, as bodily members discussed in compensation law
key_terms.سَوَاءٌ: equal, meaning the compensation does not differ among them
key_terms.نَعَمْ: an affirmative reply establishing the ruling

ai.seo_question: Are the fingers and teeth equal in diyah according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling that the fingers are equal in diyah, and likewise the teeth are equal in diyah. It reflects the jurisprudential principle of equal compensation among these corresponding body parts.
